sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Bachelor’s by end of summer 2027 required. Ideal - not hard cutoff - math grades≥3.5, math major or year
upper division math, analysis/abstract linear algebra familiarity. International students encouraged. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use Slate; obtain three referees/transcripts/SOP. Contact math for limited international need-based fee waiver
nomination before paying; pay locks application editing. [s1] [s3]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
Admission questions/important postpay changes: gradcoordes@uoregon.edu. Mandatory advance advisor
agreement not listed. [s1]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Slate application editable until fee paid; then updates must be communicated to math coordinator. [s1]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Math page explicitly Fall 2027 January 15, 2027. [s1]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [2027 confirmed]
Math old TOEFL 100 with speaking 26 or new 5 with speaking 5; IELTS 7 with speaking 7; DET speaking 130;
alternatively qualifying degree. Narrow miss exceptions sometimes conditional on arrival SPEAK. [s1]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Accredited U.S. degree accepted as evidence of English. Completed UChicago bachelor qualifies; in-progress
exemption handling should be confirmed. [s1]

GRE General [Unresolved]
General GRE requirement/consideration not addressed on current math page; do not infer from subject GRE
policy. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [2027 confirmed]
Recommended, not required. Institution 4846. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
All admitted PhDstudents supported by GE appointments; exact 2027 math salary not established. Full tuition
waiver plus contribution toward noninstructional fees; 95% health premium during GE terms, including eligible
dependents. Continuing non-summer GE with spring appointment may receive 85% summer premium
coverage. [s1] [s2]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Department says all incoming PhD admits supported, but guaranteed number of years not published in
checked sources. [s1] [s2]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International applicants encouraged; all incoming PhDsupport statement includes route, subject GE English
qualifications. [s1]
Conditions and duties [Unresolved]
This particular funding term was not established by the public program/admissions material checked. Obtain
the exact rule in the funding offer or from the graduate coordinator; neither eligibility nor a guaranteed
amount/duration is inferred from silence. [s1] [s4]
Extra funding application [Unresolved]
Ordinary GE selection accompanies admission; separate Vitulli/application essays and references not
established. [s1] [s2]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Vitulli Scholars receive first-year research GE appointments, without teaching/grading. Later research GE and
summer appointments possible; Palmer Graduate Travel Fellowship supports research travel. [s2]
Application fee [Standing rule]
$90 international, $70 domestic; online Visa/Mastercard/Discover. [s1] [s4]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Limited full international need waivers require program nomination; ask math. Other eligible program/research
experience discounts require verification letter. Requests usually reviewed within 5 business days; wait for
review before payment. [s3]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Nicolas Addington
Derived categories of coherent sheaves and geometric/arithmetic properties of algebraic varieties. [faculty1]
[faculty1a]

Associate Professor; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2023 preprint; listed forthcoming in JEMS · The Lichtenbaum-Quillen dimension of complex varieties
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Alexander Polishchuk
Moduli of curves, derived/A-infinity structures, mirror symmetry, and noncommutative geometry. [faculty3]
[faculty3a]
Professor; paper hosted on coauthor’s Oregon page; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2024 preprint · Convergence of integrals on the moduli spaces of curves and cographical matroids
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Nicholas Proudfoot
Geometric/combinatorial structures of matroids, arrangements, and related algebraic varieties. [faculty5]
[faculty5a]
Current Oregon faculty teaching graduate matroid geometry in Spring 2026; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2024 preprint · Convergence of integrals on the moduli spaces of curves and cographical matroids
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Complex geometry
Laura Fredrickson
Hyperkähler geometry, Hitchin/Higgs-bundle moduli, K3 limits, and gauge-theoretic geometric analysis.
[faculty7] [faculty7a]
Assistant Professor; paper found through arXiv link on official Oregon research page.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · ALG gravitational instantons and Hitchin moduli spaces, I: Torelli parameters
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Number theory
Ellen Eischen
Automorphic forms and L-functions, especially algebraic, p-adic, and geometric aspects for unitary groups.
[faculty9] [faculty9a]
Professor and Director of Graduate Studies; official directory links personal publication site.
Research evidence: 2026 online first · Constructing vector-valued automorphic forms on unitary groups
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Representation theory
Jonathan Brundan
Categorification, quantum/Lie superalgebras, Hecke-type categories, and highest-weight representation
theory. [faculty11] [faculty11a]
Professor; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Nil-Brauer categorifies the split iquantum group of rank one
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Alexander Kleshchev
Modular and spin representation theory, symmetric groups, Hecke algebras, and categorical equivalences.
[faculty13] [faculty13a]

Current faculty; paper verified on coauthor Brundan’s official Oregon page.
Research evidence: 2026 · Odd Grassmannian bimodules and derived equivalences for spin symmetric groups
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Victor Ostrik
Tensor categories, quantum/Hopf structures, and symmetric tensor categories in positive characteristic.
[faculty15] [faculty15a]
Professor; paper found via Recent Papers link on official Oregon faculty page.
Research evidence: October 2026 preprint · Lie algebras in symmetric tensor categories
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
